summary: Local standalone ChatGPT prototype: official rmcp HTTP/stdio adapter, consent-at-grant reads, native owner-approved answers, and allowlisted low-risk messages

replay.detail: Scratch-only prototype. Existing assistant claim namespaces are reused; no graph replay or live migration is performed.

schema.detail: Assistant contracts add caller-bound-allow, low-risk message/custom-reply scopes, optional recipient policy and a 30-day maximum. Rust, Swift and TypeScript clients are regenerated from schema and templates.

rules.detail: No checkpoint rules or fleet projection digest changes.

compatibility.detail: The prototype selects consent-at-grant mode explicitly. Legacy proof-gated branch APIs remain available but are not used by the adapter. New rich projections preserve the original ID-only projections.

downtime.detail: Only the isolated API harness is exercised; no real daemon is paired, granted or mutated.

manual.detail: Run the documented scratch script first. Real ChatGPT connection requires human-started Secure MCP Tunnel and human-created dev-mode app. No-auth loopback tunnel is an explicit dogfood exception; public distribution requires OAuth next.

recovery.detail: The script terminates its own processes and retains scratch evidence. The adapter has no approval signing key or daemon-control socket access.
